optimized_sql:
WITH filtered_item AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_brand_id, i_brand, i_current_price, i_wholesale_cost, i_manufact_id, i_product_name
    FROM item
    WHERE i_manufact_id = 816
),
filtered_date_dim AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_year, d_moy
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy = 11
)
SELECT 
    dt.d_year,
    fi.i_brand_id AS brand_id,
    fi.i_brand AS brand,
    SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) AS sum_agg
FROM 
    filtered_date_dim dt
JOIN 
    store_sales ss ON dt.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
JOIN 
    filtered_item fi ON ss.ss_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
GROUP BY 
    dt.d_year, fi.i_brand_id, fi.i_brand
ORDER BY 
    dt.d_year,
    sum_agg DESC,
    fi.i_brand_id
LIMIT 100
